# Inputs of the sqlcipher3 rebuild (#682). One KEY=VALUE per line, no quotes:
# .github/workflows/sqlcipher3-wheels.yml loads this file into its environment
# and check_sqlcipher.py reads the expected versions from it. Change a pin here (and the OpenSSL version in conanfile.py), push, and vendor the
# wheels the workflow builds; README.md has the steps.

# sqlcipher3 source: coleifer/sqlcipher3 tag 0.6.2 (a lightweight tag)
SQLCIPHER3_VERSION=0.6.2
SQLCIPHER3_COMMIT=14fc2632676b20011e0bba64fdda49763a2dd2ec

# SQLCipher source the amalgamation is generated from: sqlcipher/sqlcipher
SQLCIPHER_TAG=v4.19.0
SQLCIPHER_COMMIT=c4b275a47932888216bade83aff2bbc73df0ff85

# The SQLCipher release sqlcipher3 0.6.2 vendored. The workflow regenerates
# it with the same recipe and requires a byte-identical match, which proves
# the recipe is the one upstream used.
UPSTREAM_SQLCIPHER_TAG=v4.12.0
UPSTREAM_SQLCIPHER_COMMIT=ab223bd801ec225d1497a077da08777d21d1266d

# Build tools, pinned so a rebuild resolves the same way
CONAN_VERSION=2.33.0
SETUPTOOLS_VERSION=84.0.0

# What the built module must report. The wheel's version carries them as a
# local label so pip, the SBOM and `pip show` all name the real libraries.
SQLCIPHER_VERSION=4.19.0
